name: SOC 2 Trust Services Criteria (technical evidence subset)
disclaimer: Mapping is not certification. SOC 2 opinions depend on organizational controls, policies, monitoring, and auditor evidence that CommitGuard does not produce.

controls.title: Logical access security and software protection
controls.note: Technical evidence only; access provisioning and review are organizational.

controls.title: Protection against external threats
controls.note: Requires corroborating monitoring and incident-response evidence.

controls.title: Detection and monitoring of vulnerabilities
controls.note: CommitGuard provides scan evidence, not continuous monitoring certification.

controls.title: Change management
controls.note: Technical gate evidence only; change approval and segregation of duties are organizational.
